name: Caliz
source:
One day protagonist confesses his feelings to one of the maids that brought him up. The feelings are mutual, and two young persons get involved into passionate relationship. It's two more weeks till father arrives from the overseas trip. Let's have fun during this time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，主人公向一名从小把自己抚养长大的女仆告白。两人彼此相爱，随即展开了一段热烈的恋情。距离父亲结束海外旅行归来还有两周，就趁这段时间尽情享受吧。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
